## ✨ Added

- **Sign-in through your own login provider.** New advanced fields **Login provider URL**, **Login client ID** and **Login role claim** connect OpenCloud to Authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID or another OpenID Connect provider, with accounts created at the first sign-in and roles from the provider if you like. You no longer edit `proxy.yaml` or `csp.yaml` for it, and the [guide](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/opencloud/blob/main/docs/guide.md#sign-in-through-your-own-login-provider-optional) lists what to set up at the provider. Thanks to @montydepaola ([#123](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/opencloud/issues/123)) for the idea.
- **Your own Content-Security-Policy lines survive a restart.** Put them into `csp.local.yaml` next to `csp.yaml` in the Config folder, and the container merges them with what the web office and the login provider need at every start, without duplicates.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **fast-xml-parser 5.12.0 for the branding app's build.** It clears the low-severity advisory in the tools that build the branding web extension.

## ⚡ Improved

- Updated dependencies: Vite 8.3.8 and the OpenCloud TypeScript config 8.2.2 for the branding app, and newer digests for the Go and Node.js build images.
- Every build now boots the image with a stand-in for the server and checks the variables and the `csp.yaml` the entrypoint hands over.
